brief_rationale: The doctor correctly identified time-sensitive recurrent pneumothorax and gave appropriate urgent evaluation and safety-net instructions. However, RC2 was not met: the doctor failed to elicit key red flag status (oxygen saturation, ability to speak full sentences, ability to lie flat) in the first response before closure, instead asking the family to return with results. RC6 was also not met: no concrete receipt or teach-back was obtained. These are minor chain errors capping the grade at 2 (Borderline).
